description: Writfold KB: a brief, the plan position, an inbox and a behind-remote line (local refs only) at session start, and the plan position again after compaction; local checkpoint drafts at compaction, stop and session end; an optional delivery guard before Bash and MCP tool calls, off unless the KB has .writfold/deliveries/guard.toml (a guard, not enforcement). Each hook exits 0 and prints nothing when writfold is not on PATH or there is no KB.

hooks.command: command -v writfold >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec writfold kb hook session-start
command -v writfold >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec writfold kb hook pre-compact
command -v writfold >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec writfold kb hook post-compact
command -v writfold >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec writfold kb hook stop
command -v writfold >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec writfold kb hook pre-tool-use
command -v writfold >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec writfold kb hook session-end
